label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y lo verá el sacerdote en el día el séptimo; si extendiendo se extendiere en la piel, y lo impurecerá el sacerdote; plaga de tsaráat ella.
spanish: Y lo verá el sacerdote en el día el séptimo; si extender extendiere en la piel, y lo impurecerá el sacerdote; plaga de lepra ella.
grammarChanges: Removed the unmarked reflexive 'se' from 'se extendiere' (h03013027007): תִפְשֶׂה is qal imperfect 3fs with no reflexive/niphal stem, so no 'se' is licensed.

Replaced the gerund 'extendiendo' with the bare infinitive 'extender' before 'extendiere' (h03013027006, h03013027007), so the qal infinitive absolute plus imperfect no longer reads as a manner gerund and instead stands as the same-root emphasis pair, matching the fix already applied to this construction elsewhere in the corpus (e.g. Levítico 5:19, 7:24).

tsaráat → lepra (h03013027013; H6883, common feminine singular absolute noun, not a locked proper name), following the lexical choice already fixed for H6883 across sibling verses in this chapter (13:2, 13:11, 13:12, 13:13, 13:15, 13:20, 13:25).
readerNote: Chose the bare infinitive 'extender' over a gerund for the infinitive-absolute-plus-imperfect pair ('extender extendiere'), which also removes the unlicensed reflexive 'se'; used 'lepra' for tsaráat per the corpus-wide rendering already fixed in sibling verses. No participant, number, or stem force was changed.
